verdict.rationale: Swell documents a secret-key Backend API and registrable webhooks that call a URL when model events occur, and it lists orders among its core models, so an agent could plausibly watch order events and act on them without the admin. The pack has no order-specific documentation for status transitions, fulfillment or shipments, or returns, so only the generic API-and-webhook base is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented order status endpoints, fulfillment/shipment API, returns/RMA API, order-specific webhook event list, and hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end headless post-purchase flow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can take an order through its post-purchase lifecycle — status, fulfillment, returns — via documented APIs and webhooks without a human in the admin

citations.quote: Webhooks enable real-time communication between the Swell platform and external services, by subscribing to any number of model events.
Webhooks can be configured to call a URL when a particular event occurs, enabling outgoing calls to external services.
